features.name: Project bootstrap and configuration
features.description: Initialize the Go module, CLI entrypoint, typed YAML configuration, prompt/risk taxonomy loading, validation, and example configuration.

features.name: JSONL import and SQLite state
features.description: Import extensible JSONL records, normalize optional response, enforce trace_id idempotency, persist ordered task/item/attempt state, and recover interrupted processing.

features.name: OpenAI-compatible structured annotation
features.description: Implement the OpenAI-compatible client, structured-output modes, response parsing, schema checks, and MASB cross-field validation.

features.name: Concurrent runner and retry policy
features.description: Add the bounded worker pool, concurrency/RPM/TPM limits, shared 429 cooldown, classified retries, format repair, graceful shutdown, and durable retry scheduling.

features.name: Ordered export and operator workflow
features.description: Export successful and failed JSONL deterministically, report safe progress without payload logging, document run/resume/tuning behavior, and provide examples.

features.name: Full verification and handoff
features.description: Run formatting, unit/integration tests, race detection, vet, parser fuzz smoke checks, and record final evidence and residual risks.
